item.title: Man dies after attackers trap hands in car windows, drag him for 1.5km - video
item.description: A 37-year-old man, Biru Singh Bhadauriya, died after being assaulted in Kanpur's Hanumant Vihar area. The attack happened on Tuesday night when he was returning home from a Dussehra fair. His assailants allegedly trapped his hands in the car windows and dragged him for 1.5 kilometers. After the incident, Bhadauriya was taken to Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital where he later died.
item.dc:creator: FAIZ RAHMAN SIDDIQUI

item.title: Google co-founder Larry Page leaves California ahead of billionaire tax vote
item.description: As Californians gear up to cast their votes on Proposition 40, which suggests a one-time tax on billionaires, notable figures like Larry Page have relocated their businesses far from the state's reach to evade this tax burden. While the tax could potentially rake in $100 billion, the exodus of these wealthy individuals—who would collectively owe around $29 billion—poses a serious threat to California's expected income from this tax initiative.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Wife’s father paid for joint house; Kerala HC orders husband to vacate
item.description: The dispute involved a couple who got married in 2012. The woman told the court that her father had paid Rs 30 lakh to purchase the house for her future security. Although the property was registered jointly, she maintained that her husband had contributed nothing towards the purchase and therefore had no independent entitlement to half of it.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Sheetal Devi, Toman Kumar win compound mixed team gold at Asian Para Games
item.description: India's Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar won the gold medal in the compound mixed team event at the Asian Para Games on Thursday. The Indian pair defeated Indonesia’s Teodora Audi Ayudia Ferelly and Ken Swagumilang 151-148 in the final. The top-seeded Indian team stayed ahead for most of the contest and held on to win by three points.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Paid Rs 1 lakh for gold chain, got nothing; jeweller ordered to pay Rs 1.3 lakh
item.description: Himachal Pradesh state consumer commission upheld a decision directing Shri Ganesh Jewellers to refund Rs 1 lakh. Customer M R Chauhan made an advance payment for a gold chain that was never delivered. Despite repeated requests and a police complaint, the jeweller failed to return the money. The commission awarded compensation of Rs 20,000 for mental harassment and Rs 10,000 for litigation costs.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: ICAI CA Inter September 2026 result declared: Check scorecard and pass percentage
item.description: ICAI CA Inter September 2026 result: ICAI has declared the CA Intermediate September 2026 results on October 22. Candidates can check their scores and access the merit list through caresults.icai.org using their six-digit roll number and registration number. The results portal also provides access to the Intermediate unit examination result. May 2026 pass rates are included for comparison, while September session statistics should be confirmed through official announcements. Candidates should review their marks and check ICAI notices for verification procedures and subsequent course requirements.
item.dc:creator: TOI Education

item.title: Emma Stone bought LA home for $2.3m, sold it for $4.3m five years later
item.description: Emma Stone has beautifully transformed a historic home in Los Angeles, which she bought for $2.3 million back in 2019. After completing significant renovations, she listed the property for $3.995 million in January 2024. Boasting a guesthouse, a larger kitchen, and preserved architectural features, the home quickly sold for $4.3 million just ten days later, showcasing Stone’s savvy real estate acumen.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: 1,250-year-old Japanese pagoda with printed prayer sold for $40,960
item.description: A remarkable miniature wooden pagoda tied to Empress Shotoku has been sold for an impressive $40,960, shattering expectations. This pagoda, which houses an ancient Buddhist prayer, marks a crucial moment in Japan's printing history. Commissioned in 770 CE, it was crafted to help disseminate prayers throughout temples. At just 21.

item.title: Anand Mahindra recalls Rishikesh's Chotiwala as his filmmaking 'canteen'
item.description: Anand Mahindra reminisced about his filmmaking experiences in Rishikesh, a town infused with cultural depth. He fondly recalled Chotiwala restaurant, a hub of local cuisine, and the spiritual aura of Swargashram, where he captured the essence of a sadhu for his thesis. Rishikesh, also famed for the Beatles Ashram, continues to attract global travelers. Mahindra expresses hope that, despite modern changes, the town's unique spirit remains intact.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: US, Israel prepare for fresh Iran strikes as Tehran threatens with ‘Father of All Bombs’
item.description: The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss military options recently. Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen's $640K charity donations spark scrutiny
item.description: A 2022 report revealed that Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen’s Luz Foundation donated $640,402 to various organisations between 2007 and 2019, raising questions about its charitable giving compared with their substantial fortune. The foundation supported environmental, meditation and wellness causes. Separately, Brady’s TB12 Foundation faced scrutiny after reports said it paid his for-profit company more than $1.6 million. The couple also donated 750,000 meals to Feeding Tampa Bay in 2020.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Patrick Mahomes faces tough Chiefs reality as Brittany Mahomes draws attention
item.description: Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs have opened the 2026 NFL season with a perfect 5-0 record after a disappointing 2025 campaign. However, tougher opponents, including the Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos, could test their momentum. As the schedule intensifies, Mahomes faces growing pressure to maintain his form. Brittany Mahomes may notice a change in the atmosphere at home if the Chiefs struggle during their demanding stretch of games.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Decoding the business of bringing Brazil, Uruguay, Panama to India for football friendlies
item.description: From securing international teams to managing logistics, sponsorships and ticket sales, the recent high-profile international football matches that brought Panama, Brazil and Uruguay to India are expensive propositions. The promoter explains why commercial returns are not always guaranteed and why government backing could be crucial to building the market.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: Man finds black rubber piece in juice bottle, wins Rs 22,340 from consumer court
item.description: A consumer based in Haryana discovered a troubling foreign object—a black rubber piece—inside a Fresca Litchi Drink bottle. This alarming find prompted the individual to seek compensation, leading the district consumer commission to investigate. Tests confirmed the drink was unsafe due to the contaminant. Consequently, Fresca Foods was deemed liable for the quality concerns raised and was ordered to compensate the consumer with Rs 22,340.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Confidence in poll key for democracy, halt candidates' list: SC to Andhra poll body
item.description: Senior advocate Maninder Singh, who appeared for YSRCP, said in 19 of the 100 urban local bodies — 13 municipal corporations and 87 municipalities/nagar panchayats — more than 63% of YSRCP candidates were prevented from filing nominations or their nomination papers were torn. Senior advocate Sidharth Luthra, for AP govt, said YSRCP was importing criminal elements from as far as Punjab and fomenting violence only to cry wolf later.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: Kuwait-flagged tanker carrying 21 Indian seafarers hit by projectile in Hormuz
item.description: A Kuwait-flagged oil product tanker, M/T Al Dasma, was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. All 21 Indian seafarers aboard the vessel were reported safe after the incident on October 21. This event follows previous attacks on vessels in the region, raising safety concerns for Indian mariners. The Indian government is in contact with ship management to ensure ongoing security measures.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: ‘I will come for them’: Elon Musk threatens Democrats over plans to probe his empire
item.description: Elon Musk has issued a warning to Democratic lawmakers considering an investigation into his businesses. He stated his intent to pursue those behind such actions if Democrats gain congressional control. Concerns have been raised about potential conflicts of interest regarding Musk's federal contracts and subsidies. The proposed investigations also include scrutiny of Musk’s decisions regarding Starlink services in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Historic win! India's Anahat stuns 8-time World Champion Nour ElSherbini
item.description: Eighteen-year-old Anahat Singh stunned eight-time world champion Nour ElSherbini 11-8, 11-8, 11-7 in 30 minutes at the Silicon Valley Open on Wednesday. The Indian advanced to the quarter-finals of the USD 143,500 PSA Gold event. Earlier, Singh defeated Nour Aboulmakarim in the opening round. The victory marked the biggest win of her professional career, strengthening her reputation as a rising squash star.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: French riots and Indian protests linked in same ecosystem: Report
item.description: Senior editor Asra Nomani’s investigation says it has identified 101 organisations across nine countries in a “red-green protest ecosystem” (referring to Islamist and communist groups) that are coordinating, organising or amplifying protests in Europe in an expanding protest ecosystem. Her story also flags how transnational anti-capitalist organisation Progressive International (PI) explicitly grouped the current protests in France, Spain, India and Albania.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: Who is Suvarna Raj? Asian Para Games gold medallist who is also an advocate
item.description: Suvarna Raj, a 44-year-old para-athlete from Greater Noida, won gold for India in the women's F54 discus throw at the Asian Para Games on Thursday. She finished first with a best throw of 15.66m, adding another medal to her international career.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: ‘Badr MoU’ won’t put New Delhi-Jakarta missile contracts in jeopardy, experts say
item.description: Will 'Badr MoU' put India’s recent defence agreements with Indonesia on advanced weaponry in jeopardy? Talking to TOI, Sudhir Kumar Mishra, DRDO chair (emeritus) and former director general, CEO & MD of BrahMos Aerospace, said, “Defence agreements with Indonesia have been done with enough safeguards and that only user manual, not technology of transfer manual, will be shared with Jakarta.”
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: One killed, 8 injured in Saudi airport attack amid US order for diplomats to leave
item.description: The United States ordered some of its diplomats and the family members of US government employees to leave Saudi Arabia late on Wednesday. The move followed a series of deadly attacks attributed to Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels and growing concerns that the conflict could escalate further. The latest violence has raised concerns about the security of Saudi Arabia's critical infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Sexual offence charge rocks India's Asian Para Games contingent; swimmer faces ban
item.description: A senior PCI official, who is part of the Indian delegation in Nagoya and who handled the entire situation, confirmed the development to TOI, describing the alleged misconduct as “reprehensible and intolerable” and saying there could be “no justification” for such behaviour by an athlete representing the country on the international stage.”
item.dc:creator: SABI HUSSAIN

item.title: Brent crude tops $110 as fresh attacks in Saudi raise concerns over oil supplies
item.description: Oil prices surged past $110 a barrel as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia raised alarms. The US took precautionary measures by evacuating diplomats' families from the kingdom amid escalating security issues. Simultaneously, US crude inventories dropped sharply, while distillate stocks showed an unexpected increase. Heightened threats to energy supplies from Iran have intensified concerns over shipping safety.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: India deal pretty close, will be different: Trump; pact to exclude unresolved sectors
item.description: There has been speculation in certain quarters that the much-awaited deal may not be comprehensive, covering all sectors, and the two sides may like to leave aside the issues which have been particularly nettlesome to have an understanding on those for which they have been able to hammer out agreements.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Asian Para Games: Swati Chaudhary bags silver in women's W1 archery
item.description: Swati Chaudhary achieved a silver medal in the women's W1 individual archery event at the Asian Para Games. She initially took a 4-2 lead but eventually lost the final to Cen Mengkan of China. After winning the first and third sets, Swati struggled in the fourth and fifth sets, allowing Cen to clinch the gold. This tournament adds to Swati's recent bronze medal win at the World Archery Para Series.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: At Jamnagar refinery, Rubio and Ambanis discuss energy, digital infrastructure
item.description: US President Donald Trump had earlier announced the setting up of a $300 billion refinery in US, with RIL being part of his plank to revive industry in the country and bring back jobs that were offshored. The Mukesh Ambani-led company has, however, not outlined any details. The importance of Reliance has since increased because the Jamnagar complex is where hard Venezuelan crude can be refined.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Drug menace next target, says Amit Shah; eyes 2029 deadline
item.description: Stating that an environment conducive to development has emerged in Kashmir, Northeast and LWE-hit regions, Shah particularly thanked CRPF and its CoBRA battalion as well as Chhattisgarh Police for their role in the decisive fight against LWE. The home ministry will dedicate the remaining part of 2026 and three years after that to freeing the country from the drug menace, Shah said.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: SBI confirms data leak, says 4,000 customer records identified on dark web
item.description: The disclosure follows a claim by cybersecurity monitoring account CyberPulse that a threat actor using the name Siriusim had leaked documents and personal data allegedly linked to SBI. The post claimed the dataset contained 3,75,000 rows in CSV files and 2,722 PDF documents, including customer information, loan applications, supporting documents, account-opening forms and addresses.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 'Jailer 2' crosses Rs 582 cr worldwide in 7 days, Rs 300 crore in India
item.description: In its seventh week, Jailer 2, featuring the iconic Rajinikanth and Mohanlal, experienced a slight dip in box office earnings. The film secured Rs 28.15 crore net in India, accumulating an impressive domestic total of over Rs 300 crore. Notably, the Tamil version highlighted the charts with an earning of Rs 18.50 crore on Wednesday, while its global gross exceeded Rs 582.45 crore.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: New norms for Driving Licence: Tutorial pass mark may rise to 75%
item.description: Under the proposal, the safe-driving tutorial would have to last at least 30 minutes. The higher qualifying score of 70% is aimed at making the assessment more stringent. The draft also proposes a defined procedure for online applications to change driving licence particulars, including name and address. Licencing authorities would have to approve or reject applications for changes within 15 days, giving reasons for rejection.
item.dc:creator: DIPAK K DASH

item.title: Tiger shooters got weapons via ‘dead drop’; couriers delivered guns a day earlier
item.description: Kunal, who has also been arrested, has emerged as a key character who had been in touch with gangsters Anil Pandit and Randeep Malik for over two months. He had also figured as the source of the weapon used for the murder of a forex-hawala trader in Sonipat last year, sources said.
item.dc:creator: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA

item.title: SC stays probe against Vijayan & kin for a week to enable him to move high court
item.description: Referring to Section 175(4) of BNSS, which requires a report from the public servant’s superior officer before ordering an investigation into a complaint against the public servant for acts done in discharge of official duties, the bench said, “The single judge not only directed registration of FIR, which is the mandate in SC ruling in Vijay Madanlal case, but ordered commencement of investigation and submission of final report.”
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: PM Modi has failed ‘abysmally’ on Manipur, says Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge
item.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge asked Prime Minister Narendra Modi what has happened to the Peace Committee which was announced by home minister Amit Shah in June 2023 and what action has been taken on the Supreme Court-appointed Justice Gita Mittal Committee’s recommendations. He also asked what concrete measures have been taken to restore peace, protect citizens and address the continuing security challenges in the sensitive border state.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Rosatom completes ESFAS equipment supply for Kudankulam N-plant units 3, 4
item.description: In total, about 300 items of equipment were manufactured and delivered to the plant – four sets of ESFAS CS in accordance with the number of safety instrumentation and control trains, per each power unit featuring VVER-1000 reactors. ESFAS is the system that monitors the process parameters of a power unit when there is a deviation from normal operation conditions.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH
